keywords.name: char
keywords.description: 1 byte. Unsigned unless declared signed (or -fsigned-default / #pragma cc45 signed_default).

keywords.name: short
keywords.description: 2 bytes. Unsigned unless declared signed.

keywords.name: int
keywords.description: 2 bytes. Unsigned unless declared signed.

keywords.name: long
keywords.description: 4 bytes. Unsigned unless declared signed. Returned in A/X/Y/Z (Q).

keywords.name: signed
keywords.description: A signed integer type (plain char/short/int/long are unsigned in cc45).

keywords.name: unsigned
keywords.description: An unsigned integer type (the default for plain integer types in cc45).

keywords.name: float
keywords.description: 5 bytes: the CBM 40-bit float, computed by the BASIC 65 ROM. double and long double are the same.

keywords.name: double
keywords.description: 5 bytes: the same CBM 40-bit float as float.

keywords.name: void
keywords.description: No value; void * is a 2-byte pointer.

keywords.name: _Bool
keywords.description: 1 byte; any non-zero value stored becomes 1. <stdbool.h>: bool, true, false.

keywords.name: struct
keywords.description: A structure. Packed (no padding; _Alignof(int) == 1). cc45 adds methods, single inheritance, virtual/final and operator overloading.

keywords.name: union
keywords.description: A union.

keywords.name: enum
keywords.description: An enumeration (int-sized constants).

keywords.name: typedef
keywords.description: A type name.

keywords.name: const
keywords.description: Read-only.

keywords.name: volatile
keywords.description: Every access made (hardware registers).

keywords.name: restrict
keywords.description: The only pointer to its object.

keywords.name: static
keywords.description: File scope: not exported. In a function: kept between calls.

keywords.name: extern
keywords.description: Defined elsewhere.

keywords.name: register
keywords.description: Accepted; cc45 allocates registers itself.

keywords.name: inline
keywords.description: A hint to inline (-O2 inlines small functions anyway; __forceinline / always_inline force it).

keywords.name: if
keywords.description: if (condition) statement [else statement]

keywords.name: else
keywords.description: The other branch of an if.

keywords.name: switch
keywords.description: switch (value) { case ...: } — case ranges (case 1 ... 5:) and continue <value> (jump to that case) are extensions.

keywords.name: case
keywords.description: A switch label; case low ... high: a range.

keywords.name: default
keywords.description: The switch label for any other value.

keywords.name: while
keywords.description: while (condition) statement

keywords.name: do
keywords.description: do statement while (condition);

keywords.name: for
keywords.description: for (init; condition; step) statement

keywords.name: repeat
keywords.description: cc45: repeat (n) statement — the statement n times.

keywords.name: break
keywords.description: Leave the loop or switch; break N leaves N levels (cc45).

keywords.name: continue
keywords.description: The loop's next iteration; in a switch, continue <value> jumps to that case (cc45).

keywords.name: return
keywords.description: Leave the function, with a value.

keywords.name: goto
keywords.description: Jump to a label; goto *p (computed goto, &&label) is supported.

keywords.name: sizeof
keywords.description: The size in bytes (int 2, long 4, float 5, pointer 2, __far pointer 4).

keywords.name: _Alignof
keywords.description: The alignment (1 for most types: structs are packed).

keywords.name: _Alignas
keywords.description: _Alignas(N): aligned globals, statics, SAC locals, members and struct types (not stack locals).

keywords.name: _Static_assert
keywords.description: _Static_assert(constant, "message")

keywords.name: _Generic
keywords.description: _Generic(expr, type: value, ..., default: value)

keywords.name: _Complex
keywords.description: Complex numbers (struct _Complex_int / _Complex_float with operators; __real__, __imag__, 2.0i).

keywords.name: __far
keywords.description: On a pointer: a 4-byte far pointer (28-bit address, read and written with [bp],z). On a function: kept in far memory (an automatic mapped overlay).

keywords.name: __near
keywords.description: A 1-byte near pointer: an offset in the base page ($00,x).

keywords.name: __zp
keywords.description: A global in the program's private base page (placed by ln45 at the top of $80-$F1). __zp __bit: base-page booleans (smb/rmb/bbs).

keywords.name: __bit
keywords.description: A file-scope boolean packed 8 to a byte.

keywords.name: __fixed
keywords.description: __fixed(I, F): fixed point, I + F = 16 or 32 bits (__fixed8_8, __fixed16_16).

keywords.name: __int
keywords.description: __int(N): an N-bit integer (64 and 128: <intwide.h> structs; 8/16/32: char/int/long).

keywords.name: __bank
keywords.description: __bank(n): a variable in bank 4/5 or attic RAM, or a __far function kept in bank n.

keywords.name: __section
keywords.description: __section("NAME"): placed in the section NAME (#pragma section("NAME", addr), ln45 --section).

keywords.name: __interrupt
keywords.description: An interrupt handler: saves the registers and base page, ends with RTI.

keywords.name: __naked
keywords.description: No prologue or epilogue: the body (inline asm) does everything.

keywords.name: __fastcall__
keywords.description: The ZP calling convention for this function in a -fno-zpcall file.

keywords.name: __regparm
keywords.description: Parameters in registers.

keywords.name: __pure
keywords.description: No side effects (calls may be combined or removed); __attribute__((pure)) / ((const)).

keywords.name: __noescape
keywords.description: A constant kept with its code (in the overlay or __far chunk).

keywords.name: __likely
keywords.description: if (__likely(cond)): the branch expected taken.

keywords.name: __unlikely
keywords.description: if (__unlikely(cond)): the branch expected not taken.

keywords.name: __jsr
keywords.description: __jsr(addr, .A = v, .X -> x): call an address with registers (a ROM address through __rom_calli).

keywords.name: __jmp
keywords.description: __jmp(addr): jump to an address.

keywords.name: __dma_copy
keywords.description: __dma_copy(dst, src, len): a DMA copy (16-bit addresses).

keywords.name: __dma_fill
keywords.description: __dma_fill(dst, value, len): a DMA fill (16-bit addresses).

keywords.name: asm
keywords.description: asm("..."): ca45 assembly in a function, or at file scope (module-level assembly).

keywords.name: __attribute__
keywords.description: GCC attributes: aligned, noinline, always_inline, section, weak (use #pragma weak), pure, const, ...
